text:
Alex: Morning — async standup. What I did: landed kernel memcpy reduction (PR #4523), ran microbatch perf on g5.2x (3 runs). Blockers: KV cache eviction seems to thrash on long-tail keys, seeing ~98% miss for some traces. Today: add more eviction instrumentation, run 100k-token bench, and request @Chen review on the kernel change. Quick log: `ERROR kv: eviction: shard=7 evicted=128 miss_rate=0.98`

Chen: Nice work on memcpy reduction, saw the PR. I left nits about alignment and a comment about SIMD fallback. For the KV issue can you share a short trace? My hunch is shard mapping + TTL combo causing hotset churn.

Alex: Pasted small trace (filtered):
```
conv:5492 touch=1 last=1768999001 freq=2
conv:10732 touch=48 last=1769001203 freq=48
conv:34 touch=0 last=1768990000 freq=0
``` 
Seems a few keys with high touch overshadow many cold keys.

Taylor: FYI I'm running a kv-bench with new eviction params: `--ttl=600 --buckets=512`. Early result: overall miss rate down ~12% but p95 latency up ~6ms. Will open a config PR so we can iterate.

Maria: Rolling the kernel patch to canary group on Dedicated. Keep an eye on the per-token latency dashboard and the canary health table. Autoscaler already bumped canary from 2->4, so capacity is fine.

deploy-bot: deploy 1769a2c -> canary succeeded (3 nodes). start=2026-02-21T09:00:12Z finish=2026-02-21T09:02:01Z :white_check_mark:

Chen: I'll review the kernel PR tonight and add a microbench for the memcpy path. For KV eviction, propose we add a histogram of per-key inter-touch to better see the hotset shape.

Jamal: I can provision a larger harness (8xA100) to run the 100k-token sweep if you want stable tail estimates. Ping me when configs are ready.

Taylor: +1 on the histogram. Also we should test continuous batching with kv-cache enabled; I'm prepping a script that toggles batching window and kv on/off and will post results.

Alex: Thanks all — plan: instrument eviction, re-run 100k token bench at ~13:30 PT, push updated bench config to the repo, and ping @Jamal when ready. Blocker for now: need review from @Chen to merge the kernel change that reduces memcpy. :rocket:
